verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents several native AI features that produce insights/suggestions from platform data — AI-powered evidence gap analysis (validates evidence for relevance/scope/timeliness), AI risk scoring for AI systems, and an AI Editor for building ingestion workflows via natural language — all from first-party docs. However these are narrow, workflow-specific AI features rather than a broad AI-insights layer across all data, and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of their real-world quality. Missing for 10: independent verification of AI-generated insight quality, broader cross-module AI analytics (not just evidence/risk/workflow niches), and user testimonials confirming value.
